$comment: Per-shot settings for tools/photo/clean_lightbox.py. Coordinates are pixels in the oriented original. F02 side (A3) from the wearer's right; the photographer focused on the temple and let the front run off the edge, so the photographer's crop is kept, ending just past the near rim: beyond it the far side is a blur the segmentation can't hold. The right wing is well out of focus: the GCD goes where the pin heads sit (about 39% and 61% across the wing's face, 53% down, as on IMG_3423), seen at about 40 degrees, and is softened to the same blur.

marks.name: printed wordmark and old emblem on the near temple
